name: keller-hvac-services
description: Keller HVAC Services website — Next.js frontend, NestJS API, SQLite3 database

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.js && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
